ns2:section.sectionText: Classroom Language Acquisition Research Some questions we will investigate include: ? Does (type of) instruction make a difference? ? Are all aspects of language teachable? ? Is earlier always better? ? Is second language acquisition different from heritage language acquisition? How or how not? In this course you will: ? Read primary literature (journal articles and refereed book chapters) on various strands of classroom language acquisition research ? Be part of a research apprenticeship, during which you will design your own classroom language acquisition research study
